title: Filters accept at most 50 picked values in total
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a staging location with more than 55 customers invoiced this month.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Tick 50 customers in the Customer filter.
  3. Tick one more customer.
  4. Open the Priced By filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • 50 customers are ticked.

Step 3:

  • The 51st customer is not taken: 50 stay ticked.
  • The report shows the 50 customers' rows.

Step 4:

  • Priced By still has every option ticked (All).
  • Those ticks do not count toward the 50.
